title: Nimbus pricing, multi-turn
prompt: Summarize everything you know about Nimbus pricing
description: Retrieval, then a docs search, a calculation and another search: the context grows every turn.

turns.say: The plan prices are in the context. Let me look for discounts too.
Annual billing saves two months. Computing the yearly Team price.
One more search for usage charges.

Nimbus pricing: Starter 9 EUR, Team 49 EUR and Scale 199 EUR per month [02-pricing]. Paying yearly saves two months, so Team costs {{calculate.result}} EUR per year. Non-profits and open source maintainers get 50% off Team, students get Starter free for a year [05-discounts]. Extra bandwidth is 0.05 EUR per GB and extra storage 0.20 EUR per GB per month [04-usage-billing].
